summary: A diary counts small sums in exact amounts.
realLife: Pepys recorded giving twenty shillings to a town's bonfire; Young recorded six dollars for one assessing job.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, May 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/May
Kansas Historical Quarterly, A Hoosier in Kansas: the diary of Hiram H. Young, 1890 to 1891: https://www.kansashistory.gov/p/kansas-historical-quarterly-a-hoosier-in-kansas-2/13032
inGame: The wage moves; `wage` is an hourly figure from the pay record (a flat sum is a gap).

turns.writesBack: the entry says about how much
